_comment: Fictional, non-graphic workplace cases for Carthage Demo Systems. All names map to seed/workforce/employees.csv. Cases are confidential: visible only to parties and the assigned mediator. Cases never enter the graph database.

cases.intake_text: I feel the backend tickets are not shared fairly on our squad. For the last three sprints most of the on-call and urgent fixes have landed on me while similar work gets reassigned away from a colleague. I have raised it in stand-up but nothing changed. I would like a neutral review of how tickets are distributed before the next sprint planning.

Design feedback is reaching me very late in the cycle and often rewrites decisions we already agreed on. It makes planning hard and I end up redoing finished work. I am not questioning anyone's intentions, I just think we need a clearer feedback step and deadlines so we both know when input is final.

I keep getting the late evening support shifts far more often than the rest of the team, including two weekends in a row. I understand coverage is hard, but I would like the rotation to be reviewed so it is more even across everyone.
cases.resolution: A rotation review was run with the full Support team. The evening and weekend slots were rebalanced using a fixed rotation and shared with everyone. Both parties agreed to revisit in one month.
